label: Bible Study
prompt: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too _____ for thee:
verse: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
note: Jeremiah prays this while buying a field in a city about to fall — faith with a deed attached.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he took them up in his _____, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
verse: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
note: Jesus didn't just tolerate the children — He scooped them up in His arms and blessed them.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the _____ person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verse: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
note: Peter calls Noah 'the eighth person' — one of eight saved on the ark — and a preacher of righteousness.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is _____ come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
verse: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
note: The Bible's last invitation: the Spirit, the bride and every hearer say come — and the water is free.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which _____ not.
verse: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
note: 'The law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not' — the legal trap that sent Daniel to the lions' den.
